app.support: One Platform. Any Screen. Your Way.
app.principle: Your Screen. Your Data. Your Control.
app.privacy: Settings stay in this browser. Remembered devices use a secure cookie, not localStorage tokens. Observations are not cached offline.
app.install: Install from your browser menu on HTTPS or localhost.

config.name: Device name
config.tokenHint: Kept in this page memory only
config.connectHint: Real data is not connected. Enter a device read-only token or scan your administrator’s private pairing QR code. This screen is not yet ready for live-data acceptance.

status.sync: Last service sync: {time} · Polls every 30 seconds
status.safe: This widget contains no account quota or private content.
status.failure: Connection failed ({status}). Cached observations may be stale.
status.network: Connection failed or timed out. Cached observations may be stale.

widget.empty: Connect to view observations. Missing quota is never estimated.

data.demo: Demo Data · Fixed examples, not real account quotas.
data.quota_unavailable: The connector returned no usable quota windows.
data.codex_read_failed: Codex query failed. Check CLI, sign-in and network.
data.demo_fixed: Demo Data · Fixed example, not a real account quota.
data.chatgpt_unavailable: ChatGPT personal subscription quota is not connected.
data.legacy: No localized detail is available for this record.

display.installHint: On iPhone, use Safari Share → Add to Home Screen. Wake lock depends on the browser, power mode and system.

auth.expired: Device authorization is invalid or expired. Scan your pairing QR again.
auth.loginFailed: Device sign-in failed. Check the connection and allow cookies for this site.
auth.logoutFailed: Data cleared on this page, but server sign-out is incomplete. Reconnect and select Sign out again.

system.title: System monitor
system.empty: No authorized system observations. Requires a system-scoped device token and a Linux collector.

ui.subtitle: Usage, host health, project activity and personal information.
ui.refreshHint: Reads the latest server data; does not trigger collection.

info.empty: No authorized observations. Configure a collector and pair a scoped device.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.local: Device-local date · no calendar account connected

weather.title: Weather
weather.empty: No authorized weather. Configure a city and pair a weather-scoped device.

orbit.rhythm: 30 s web read cycle · not upstream collection
orbit.noQuota: No authorized Codex quota on this device

settings.title: Settings
settings.local: Saved automatically in this browser only; other screens are unchanged.
settings.saved: Saved. Changes apply immediately when returning to Orbit.
settings.wakeHint: Display mode requests a screen wake lock; availability depends on the browser and OS.
settings.privateHidden: Private data is hidden. Scan a pairing code to sign in again.
settings.temporary: Temporary sign-in. Reloading or closing this page requires pairing again.
settings.signedOut: This browser is not signed in.
settings.pairHint: Scan the private pairing code from your administrator. Safari and the home-screen app may need separate sign-ins.
settings.tokenPrivate: Use only to restore sign-in. Never share tokens or pairing codes.
settings.debugHint: Administrator troubleshooting only. Demo mode does not represent real account data.
settings.unsaved: This browser cannot save preferences. Changes apply now but may reset after reopening.
settings.logoutHint: Signing out clears private data on this page. Scan a pairing code to sign in again. Other devices stay signed in.

layout.title: Orbit layout
layout.hint: Changes save in this browser. Return to preview immediately. Layout preferences do not grant data access.
layout.pair: Connect a device to edit the layout and read its server recommendation.

themes.title: Theme
themes.hint: Theme default uses light Paper and dark for the other themes. Aurora respects motion and reduced-motion settings; power use has not been measured.

city.title: Weather city
city.hint: Search and select a city; device location is never read. Each screen may choose a different city. Weather uses the city time zone; the main clock still uses this device time.
city.name: City name
city.noResults: No available city found. Add a country or region and retry.
city.searchError: City search unavailable or rate limited. Please retry later.
city.permission: Real mode and weather read permission are required to choose a city.

admin.title: Device management
admin.heading: A place for every screen.
admin.intro: Assign layouts to screens and revoke access when needed. Administrator sign-in is separate from display sign-in.
admin.keyHint: Use a dedicated administrator key created on your server. Display and collector tokens cannot administer devices.
admin.bootstrap: First create a key locally on the server; there is no default password. Use the same database path as the server.
admin.inventoryHint: Valid authorization does not mean online. Sessions count unexpired browser logins. Use each pairing code for one physical device.
admin.newHint: Create a separate read-only authorization for this screen. Select only necessary sources. Web provisioning grants real mode only.
admin.name: Device name
admin.newProfileHint: The new device starts with the draft under Layout publication below.
admin.pairHint: Scan on the new phone. This code contains access credentials and is shown only now. It hides on dismissal, backgrounding or after 10 minutes; hiding does not revoke access. Revoke and recreate if lost. Do not publicly share screenshots or links.
admin.configError: Configuration invalid; publication disabled. Repair with server tools or revoke this device.
admin.revokeHint: Revoke “{name}”? Its token and current sessions will immediately stop working. Other devices are unaffected.
admin.policyHint: Policies only narrow original grants. rules: null preserves them; {} denies all. Loosening a restriction cannot add a new source grant. Saved policies apply to existing sessions immediately.
admin.publishHint: Select up to 20 active devices above, then publish one layout. Screens read recommendations on their next refresh (usually within 30 seconds). Local customizations remain until Restore server recommendation is selected on that screen. Publication never adds data access.
admin.import: Import layout JSON exported by a display
admin.maxTargets: Publish to at most 20 devices at once.
admin.auditHint: Retains at most 1000 events; shows the latest 100. Keys, pairing codes, IPs and observation content are not logged.
admin.failed: Operation incomplete. Check your network and refresh the list to verify results before retrying; do not create duplicate devices.
admin.conflict: The configuration changed, a device is unavailable, or a limit was reached. Refresh the list before retrying.
admin.invalid: Invalid configuration. Check name, expiry, layout and original policy scope.
admin.rate: Too many requests. Try again later.
admin.signedOut: Signed out of management. Display sessions are unaffected.
admin.loaded: Device layout loaded into the publication draft.
admin.imported: Layout JSON loaded. Review before publishing.
admin.published: Layout published. Screens with local changes must select Restore server recommendation.
admin.created: Device created. Hide its pairing code after pairing.

alerts.title: Quota reminders
alerts.scope: Only in this browser while Pixora is open and connected. No background, watch, ESP32 or push delivery yet. Stored locally per paired device; uses fresh real Codex observations only. Quiet hours use this device’s local time; equal hours disable quiet time.
alerts.empty: No reminders yet. No synthetic reminder is sent.

pet.title: Companion
pet.settingsHint: Tap the quota ring to open your companion. Preferences save in this browser.
pet.name: Companion name
pet.customHint: Custom display changes animation and text only, never a Codex task. Real status remains visible.
pet.caption: Personal message
